task.description: WF-03 Step 3d for ISS-0910, idiom/scope-creep hard gate. Read git diff main...HEAD -- lib/letflow/identity/role_backfill.ex lib/mix/tasks/letflow.backfill_platform_roles.ex yourself. Check per .claude/agents/reviewer.md's four questions -- idiomatic vs. crutch (is the new reset call site's placement inside classify/3's :seeded branch clean, or does it entangle two concerns awkwardly), the accepted OQ-1 gap (separate-transaction retry hole) -- confirm it's stated honestly in code comments/docs, not silently hidden, scope creep (anything touched beyond the reset logic and the counter threading), and decision-record consistency (does this respect decision 0006's per-tenant-schema design, no tenant_id reintroduced anywhere). FAIL if a genuine crutch, broken invariant, or scope creep is found; otherwise PASS.
acceptance_criteria: the fix resets role_claims_synced_at to nil for users with a membership in each tenant in RoleBackfill.run/0's own :seeded list, not :unchanged tenants
the reset reuses sync_role_claims_from_token/3's existing gated call sites (no new sync-triggering code path invented)
the fix is idempotent -- running the backfill twice does not error and does not incorrectly re-affect already-corrected users

result.summary: Reviewed git diff main...HEAD for role_backfill.ex and its Mix task against .claude/agents/reviewer.md's four questions plus design doc lib/letflow/design/iss0910-role-backfill-resync-marker-reset.md. (1) Idiom: reset call site is clean -- gated in classify/3's existing < 6 (:seeded) branch (design shape (a)), not entangled; classify/3 stays a pure classifier plus one gated side-effect call, no case-do state-machine crutch. (2) Supervision: n/a, no process/isolation concerns in this change. (3) Type-safety: no new invalid-state class introduced; reset writes nil to an already-nullable column, no gap worth filing. (4) Scope: tight -- only role_backfill.ex (reset helper + 3-key accumulator threading) and one Mix.shell().info line in the CLI wrapper changed; identity.ex, user.ex, role_registry.ex untouched, matching design SS6. OQ-1 (separate-transaction retry hole: a tenant whose reset fails after seeding already committed reclassifies :unchanged on retry and never gets retried) is stated honestly in both the design doc (SS2, SS8) and the code's own moduledoc/run/0 @doc ('or whose marker reset, failed') -- not hidden. Verified via grep that sync_role_claims_from_token/3 and its two existing gated call sites in identity.ex are unmodified -- no new sync-triggering path invented, satisfying the acceptance criterion. Verified via Letflow.Identity.User's moduledoc and the update_all call's prefix: schema_name (no where, no tenant_id) that this is consistent with Decision 0006 D1/D2's per-tenant-schema design -- no tenant_id reintroduced anywhere. Idempotency confirmed: re-nulling an already-nil column is a no-op, and a tenant already fully seeded reclassifies :unchanged on a second run so its users are never re-touched. No crutch, no broken invariant, no scope creep found. PASS.
